title: Do Estate Farms Affect Smallholder Household Labor Decisions in sub-Saharan Africa: A Case Study of Malawi
abstract: Introduction Estate farming has been a historical part of agriculture in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). This study investigated the role that proximity to estates in Malawi had on smallholders’ allocation of labour on their own farms, as well as their supply and hiring of casual agricultural labour (ganyu).Methods This study used propensity score matching and covariate adjustments with propensity score matching to estimate the effects of proximity to estates on the time spent by smallholders on different labour activities. We used data from the 2019 Malawian Integrated Household Panel Survey (IHPS) and geospatial data from the OpenStreetMap project. Results and Discussion Our findings show that the presence of estate farms was negatively associated with the time smallholder household members spent on their own farms and was positively, albeit modestly, associated with the amount of time used for both casual labour (ganyu) supply and hiring activities. We also found that estates were negatively associated with the shares of smallholder household income that came from their own crop farming and positively associated with the shares of household income from non-crop farming activities, especially non-ganyu wage employment.
abstract_zh: 引言 大型国有农场（estate farming）是撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）农业史的一部分。本研究考察了马拉维境内靠近农场的距离对小农在自家农场的劳动时间分配，以及对其零工农业劳动（ganyu）的供给与雇用所产生的作用。方法 本研究采用倾向得分匹配以及结合协变量调整的倾向得分匹配，估计靠近农场对小农各类劳动活动所用时间的影响。我们使用了2019年马拉维综合家庭面板调查（IHPS）的数据，以及来自OpenStreetMap项目的地理空间数据。结果与讨论 我们的研究发现，农场的存在与小农家庭成员在自家农场上花费的时间呈负相关，与其用于零工农业劳动供给和雇用活动的时间呈正相关，尽管相关幅度较为有限。我们还发现，农场的存在与小农家庭收入中来自自家作物种植的份额呈负相关，与来自非作物农业活动（尤其是非零工类工资就业）的收入份额呈正相关。

Estimating the Direct and Indirect Effects of Improved Seed Adoption on Yields: Evidence from DNA-Fingerprinting, Crop cuts, and Self-Reporting in Ethiopia
abstract: Farmers' adoption of improved crop varieties could increase yields in low-income countries. However, the presence of measurement error in household surveys poses a challenge to estimating true returns. Using the 2018/19 Ethiopia Socio-economic Survey, we analyze the impacts of how three sources of measurement error: misperceptions of seed varieties, land area, and quantities harvested affect maize yields and input use. These data include DNA-fingerprinting of seed, GPS plot size information, and crop cuts that we compare to farmers’ self-reported estimates of these measures. Results indicate that the measurement error in self-reported seed variety adoption, especially from farmers who did not know they were using improved maize varieties, attenuates their estimated yield gains by 25 percentage points on average. The enhanced genetics of improved seed varieties accounts for a 41-percentage point yield increase over non-improved varieties, and increased input use accounts for a 30-percentage point gain for improved varieties on average.
abstract_zh: 农户采用改良作物品种可能提高低收入国家的产量。然而，家庭调查中存在的测量误差对估计真实收益构成挑战。利用2018/19年埃塞俄比亚社会经济调查，我们分析了三类测量误差（对种子品种的误判、土地面积以及收获量）如何影响玉米产量和投入使用。这些数据包括种子的DNA指纹鉴定、GPS地块面积信息，以及我们将其与农户自报估计值进行比较的实割样本（crop cuts）。结果表明，自报种子品种采用中的测量误差，尤其是来自那些不知道自己在使用改良玉米品种的农户的误差，平均使其估计的产量增益减少了25个百分点。改良种子的增强遗传特性使其产量比非改良品种高出41个百分点，而投入使用的增加则使改良品种平均多出30个百分点的产量增益。

title: Estimating the Effectiveness of Public versus Private Distribution Systems: Insights from a Fertilizer Policy Reform in Malawi
Signaling Quality in Informal Markets. Evidence from an Experimental Auction in the Sahel
Social networks and the demand for credence agricultural technologies
abstract: Little is known about the adoption of agricultural technologies that enhance unobservable attributes, such as food quality and food safety. Social networks can potentially be a key tool to disseminate information about such technologies, because informal discussions among network members could counter the lack of observability and awareness of the benefits of such technologies. To inform this issue, we conducted a field experiment that included experimental auctions and a lottery to estimate how social networks influence the demand for Aflasafe, a new food safety-enhancing technology, among smallholder farmers in Senegal. Aflasafe is an agricultural input that controls aflatoxins, which are unobservable carcinogenic compounds that contaminate grains and compromise their safety for human consumption. Despite the lack of any food-safety regulations or price incentives in the study area, we found that demand for Aflasafe was high at baseline after farmers were trained on its benefits. The results show that social networks increased demand for Aflasafe among participants who had a lower willingness to pay in the first period. These individuals likely needed the most convincing to adopt the technology. Further, we find suggestive evidence that having an Aflasafe adopter (“lottery winner”) who used the treated groundnut for own consumption and use as future seed in an individual’s network increases their demand. Having an adopter who used the treated groundnut for other purposes in an individual’s network is not associated with any change in an individual’s demand. These findings suggest that smallholder farmers – who are often both producers and consumers of their food – engage in discussions about technologies with unobservable benefits within their agricultural social networks. Thus, it seems possible, at least in the short term, that these networks can be harnessed to increase technology adoption by leveraging farmers’ concern about their health and food safety.
abstract_zh: 关于那些增强不可观测属性（如食品质量和食品安全）的农业技术的采用，人们了解甚少。社会网络可能成为传播此类技术信息的关键工具，因为网络成员之间的非正式讨论可以弥补此类技术不可观测性以及人们对其益处认识不足的问题。为探讨这一议题，我们开展了一项田野实验，其中包括实验拍卖和一次抽奖，以估计社会网络如何影响塞内加尔小农对Aflasafe（一种新型食品安全增强技术）的需求。Aflasafe是一种农业投入品，用于控制黄曲霉毒素；黄曲霉毒素是一类不可观测的致癌化合物，会污染谷物并损害其人类食用安全。尽管研究地区既无食品安全法规，也无价格激励，但在参与者接受了关于该技术益处的培训后，我们发现其基线需求很高。结果显示，社会网络提高了那些在第一阶段支付意愿较低的参与者对Aflasafe的需求。这些人很可能最需要说服才会采用该技术。此外，我们发现一些间接证据表明，当个人的网络中有一位使用处理过的花生自用并留作未来种子的采用者（“抽奖中奖者”）时，其需求会增加。而当其网络中的采用者将处理过的花生用于其他用途时，则与个人需求的任何变化均无关联。这些发现表明，小农（他们往往既是粮食生产者也是消费者）会在其农业社会网络中，就那些具有不可观测益处的技术展开讨论。因此，至少在短期内，似乎有可能利用这些网络，借助农户对自身健康和食品安全的关切，来促进技术采用。

title: Incentive mechanisms to exploit intra-seasonal price arbitrage opportunities for smallholder farmers: Experimental evidence from Malawi
Increasing Agricultural Productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa During Times of Volatile Prices and a Changing Climate
abstract: Increasing agricultural productivity among smallholder farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) faces numerous threats including conflict, input and output price volatility, and climate change. Inorganic fertiliser is a key input that smallholder farmers need to use to boost staple crop yields. However, inorganic fertiliser prices spiked globally in 2021/22 due to COVID-19 and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. The effect of the fertiliser price spike was longer and more pronounced in SSA than it was in the world as a whole. In this paper, I discuss factors that affected local fertiliser prices before, during, and after the price spike of 2021/22 in six African countries. I then discuss Nigeria and Zambia’s recent efforts to increase domestic inorganic fertiliser production from fossil fuels. Finally, I discuss the implications of fertiliser policy on climate change, and how increasing agricultural productivity through better fertiliser use efficiency is the only feasible near-term solution to boost food production in SSA while dealing with the crisis of a changing climate. I conclude with policy recommendations.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲小农提高农业生产率面临诸多威胁，包括冲突、投入品与产出品价格波动以及气候变化。无机化肥是小农提高主粮作物产量所需使用的关键投入品。然而，2021/22年间，由于新冠疫情以及俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，全球无机化肥价格急剧攀升。此次化肥价格飙升在撒哈拉以南非洲的持续时间和影响程度都比全球平均水平更长、更显著。本文讨论了2021/22年化肥价格飙升前后各阶段影响六个非洲国家当地化肥价格的因素。随后，我讨论了尼日利亚和赞比亚近期为增加以化石燃料为原料的国内无机化肥生产所做的努力。最后，我讨论了化肥政策对气候变化的影响，并指出，通过提高化肥利用效率来提升农业生产率，是在应对气候变化危机的同时，于近期内提高撒哈拉以南非洲粮食产量的唯一可行方案。文章最后提出政策建议。

title: Policy collision: a framework to identify where polycentric, multi-objective sustainability solutions are needed
abstract: The exploitation of ecosystem services, through processes like agricultural production, is associated with myriad negative environmental impacts, which are felt by stakeholders on local, regional, and global scales. The varying type and scale of impacts leads naturally to fragmented and siloed approaches to mitigating externalities by diverse governmental and non-governmental institutions. However, policies designed to address a single impact may worsen other negative impacts. As a result, even when groups have the expertise to design policy solutions in one dimension, policies addressing single issues may conflict and result in less than ideal outcomes in combination. In this paper, we present a conceptual framework and examples of this kind of ‘policy collision,’ where policies produce mutual negative interference so that policies designed independently may fail to achieve their goals. We argue that an integrated systems perspective is needed to overcome this problem and present several positive examples where this has been put into practice. Policy collision provides a useful framework for determining how each colliding policy should be modified in improve outcomes.
abstract_zh: 通过农业生产等过程对生态系统服务的开发，会带来诸多负面环境影响，这些影响会在地方、区域和全球各个层面被利益相关者感受到。不同类型和规模的影响，自然导致了各类政府和非政府机构在缓解外部性问题时采取碎片化和割裂化的做法。然而，旨在应对单一影响的政策可能会加剧其他负面影响。因此，即便某些群体具备在某一维度上设计政策方案的专业能力，单一议题的政策也可能相互冲突，在叠加时产生不甚理想的结果。本文提出了一个概念框架，并列举了这种“政策碰撞”（policy collision）的案例：政策之间产生相互负向干扰，使得独立设计的政策可能无法实现其目标。我们认为，需要一种综合的系统视角来克服这一问题，并介绍了若干已将该视角付诸实践的正面案例。政策碰撞框架为确定每项相互冲突的政策应如何调整以改善结果提供了有益的分析框架。

Overcoming Smallholder Farmers' Post-Harvest Constraints through Harvest Loans and Storage Technology: Insights from a Randomized Controlled Trial in Tanzania
abstract: Maintaining staple grains throughout the year and managing liquidity are two major challenges that smallholder farmers face at harvest. We implemented a randomized controlled trial in Tanzania that was designed to address these post-harvest constraints. First, we offered treated farmers two hermetic (airtight) storage bags, which helped preserve grain quantity and quality. Second, we offered other treated farmers a loan at harvest, which reduced the liquidity constraints they faced. Repayment was due with interest six months from harvest when maize prices were traditionally higher. We did not find a significant impact of the storage intervention. However, those offered the loan stored 29 percent more and sold 50 percent more maize on average in the lean season compared to farmers in the control group. Nevertheless, an unexpected maize export ban in Tanzania likely attenuated the outcomes of both interventions. This highlighted the challenges surrounding agricultural financial products in the developing world.
abstract_zh: 在全年保存主粮并管理流动性，是小农在收获季面临的两大主要挑战。我们在坦桑尼亚开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在应对这些收获后的约束。首先，我们向部分处理组农户提供了两个密封（气密）储粮袋，有助于保持粮食的数量和质量。其次，我们向另外一些处理组农户提供了收获时的贷款，缓解了他们面临的流动性约束。还款需在收获后六个月连本带息偿还，而此时玉米价格通常较高。我们没有发现储粮干预具有显著影响。然而，获得贷款的农户平均多储存了29%的玉米，并且在青黄不接的季节比对照组农户多售出50%的玉米。尽管如此，坦桑尼亚一项意外的玉米出口禁令，很可能削弱了两种干预的效果。这凸显了发展中国家农业金融产品所面临的挑战。

Absentee Tenants and Farmland Transfers in sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Malawi
abstract: We use a unique dataset from Malawi that matches tenants and their landlord counterparts to document the role played by absentee tenants, i.e. tenants who reside outside the area where the rented land is located. We found that non-local tenants made up 22% of the tenants in our sample. A significant subset of them had higher off-farm income and significantly more assets than did other tenants. Conversely, we found that 76% of landlords rented land because they needed cash. Our results highlight the fact that some rental transactions reinforce power imbalances and may exacerbate risks faced by poorer landlords.
abstract_zh: 我们利用马拉维一个独特的数据集，将佃农与其对应的地主进行匹配，以揭示缺席佃农（即居住在所租土地所在地区以外的佃农）所发挥的作用。我们发现，非本地佃农占样本中佃农的22%。其中有相当一部分人的非农收入较高，拥有的资产也显著多于其他佃农。相反，我们发现76%的地主出租土地是因为他们需要现金。我们的研究结果表明，一些租赁交易强化了权力失衡，并可能加剧较贫穷地主所面临的风险。

Willingness to pay for a new farm technology given risk preferences: Evidence from an experimental auction in Kenya
abstract: Smallholder farmers and small‐scale traders who do not have access to moisture measurement tools may not be able to fully observe moisture content in their grain. However, encouraging the adoption of these tools is important for food safety, because growth of dangerous toxins can be prevented by drying grain to 13.5% moisture content or below before storage. Several low‐cost devices have recently been developed that can accurately test moisture content in maize. In this article, we first estimate the demand for two such devices among smallholder farmers and small‐scale traders in Western Kenya. Second, we measure the impact of individuals’ risk aversion on willingness to pay for these devices. Third, we measure framing effects in experimental auctions by eliciting valuations with increasing and decreasing price lists. We found that more than 80% of respondents were willing to pay more than the wholesale price for the cheaper of the two devices. Farmers in our sample, who were growing maize primarily for own consumption, were willing to pay more than traders. Individuals who were more risk‐averse reported a slightly higher willingness‐to‐pay for these risk‐reducing devices. Finally, farmers—but not traders—were sensitive to framing effects: mean bids elicited with a decreasing price list during the auction were 37% higher than those with an increasing price list.
abstract_zh: 没有水分测量工具的小农和小规模粮商，可能无法充分观察其谷物中的含水量。然而，推广这些工具对食品安全至关重要，因为将谷物干燥至含水量13.5%或以下后再储存，可以防止危险毒素的滋生。近来已开发出多种能够精确测定玉米含水量的低成本设备。在本文中，我们首先估计了肯尼亚西部小农和小规模粮商对其中两种此类设备的需求。其次，我们测量了个人风险厌恶程度对其为这些设备支付意愿的影响。第三，我们通过分别采用递增和递减价格清单来获取估值，测量了实验拍卖中的框架效应。我们发现，超过80%的受访者愿意为两种设备中较便宜的一种支付高于批发价的价格。在我们的样本中，主要为自家消费而种植玉米的农户，比粮商愿意支付更高的价格。风险厌恶程度较高的个人，对这些降低风险设备的支付意愿略高。最后，农户——而非粮商——对框架效应十分敏感：拍卖中采用递减价格清单得出的平均报价，比采用递增价格清单得出的报价高出37%。

What drives smallholder farmers' willingness to pay for a new farm storage technology? Evidence from an Experimental Auction in Kenya
abstract: We use an incentive compatible experimental auction to measure demand for a new agricultural technology, a triple layered hermetic storage bag. When used properly, the bag creates an airtight seal that reduces storage loss from insect pests and neutralizes aflatoxin contamination in stored grain. We find that demand for this new technology is highly elastic (4.3) and that the wholesaler could increase profit by lowering the price. We also find that farmers' valuation for the bag is not significantly different based on the medium through which information about it is communicated to them, either text, audio or video messages. This suggests that practitioners should use the cheapest option for disseminating information, which is text messaging in this context. In addition, we find that farmers who have prior awareness of the bag are willing to pay 20% more on average than those previously unaware of it. In total, the highly elastic demand for the improved bags, along with the fact that prior awareness of the bag leads to higher willingness to pay, suggests that a one-time price subsidy for the new technology could spur demand and increase future adoption.
abstract_zh: 我们采用激励相容的实验拍卖，来测度一种新型农业技术的需求：一种三层密封储粮袋。在正确使用的情况下，该储粮袋形成气密封口，可减少害虫造成的储存损失，并中和储存谷物中的黄曲霉毒素污染。我们发现，这一新技术的需求富有弹性（弹性为4.3），且批发商降低价格可以增加利润。我们还发现，农户对储粮袋的估值，并不会因信息传递方式（文字、音频或视频信息）的不同而有显著差异。这表明，从业者应采用最便宜的信息传播方式，在此情境下即短信。此外，我们发现，事先了解该储粮袋的农户，其支付意愿平均比此前不了解的农户高出20%。总之，改良储粮袋的需求弹性很高，加之事先了解该产品会带来更高的支付意愿，这表明对该新技术实施一次性价格补贴，可能会刺激需求并促进未来的采用。

title: Does improved storage technology promote modern input use and food security? Evidence from a randomized trial in Uganda
How Do African Farm Households Respond to Changes in Past and Current Weather Patterns? A Structural Panel Data Analysis from Malawi
abstract: We use three waves of nationally representative household‐level panel data from Malawi to estimate a structural model characterizing the response of smallholder farm households to current and past weather patterns, and the subsequent impacts on household net income. We also quantify heterogeneity among households along the wealth spectrum regarding their ability to adapt to evolving weather patterns. This approach yields two key findings. First, adverse weather history prompts households to devote more time to maize cultivation on their own farms, to the detriment of other, possibly more remunerative income sources. Households also reduce application of productivity‐enhancing inputs, such as fertilizer and improved maize varieties, in response to adverse weather history. Our results are robust to different clustering structures and falsification tests aimed at ruling out alternative explanations to observed trends. Second, we find that, by maintaining a more diversified income structure, wealthier households are better able to adapt to adverse weather history. Consequently, adverse changes in past weather may be regressive in nature, creating a “climate‐induced” poverty trap that locks poor smallholder households into low‐value maize cultivation from season to season. This finding suggests that developing more weather‐resilient maize varieties and promoting smallholder livelihood diversification strategies may help mitigate the effects of adverse weather on the most vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 我们利用马拉维具有全国代表性的三轮家庭层面面板数据，估计了一个结构模型，用以刻画小农家庭对当前及过去天气模式的反应，以及随之对家庭净收入产生的影响。我们还量化了家庭在财富分布上的异质性，考察其适应不断变化的天气模式的能力差异。这一方法得出两项关键发现。第一，不利的天气历史促使家庭将更多时间投入自家农场的玉米种植，从而牺牲了其他可能更有收益的收入来源。面对不利的天气历史，家庭还会减少对化肥和改良玉米品种等提高生产率投入品的使用。我们的结果对不同的聚类结构以及旨在排除其他可能解释的证伪检验均保持稳健。第二，我们发现，较富裕的家庭通过维持更为多元化的收入结构，能够更好地适应不利的天气历史。因此，过去天气的不利变化可能具有累退性，从而形成一种“气候诱发型”贫困陷阱，使贫困小农家庭在季节更替中被锁定在低价值的玉米种植之中。这一发现表明，培育更具气候韧性的玉米品种，并推动小农生计多元化战略，可能有助于减轻不利天气对最脆弱家庭的影响。

title: Micro-level Welfare Impacts of Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Rural Malawi
abstract: This article analyses the micro-level welfare impacts of agricultural productivity using a two-wave nationally representative, panel data from rural Malawi. Welfare is measured by various dimensions of poverty and food insecurity; and agricultural productivity is measured by maize yield and value of crop output per hectare. The poverty measures included per capita consumption expenditure, relative deprivation in terms of per capita consumption expenditure, poverty gap and severity of poverty; and the measures of food insecurity included caloric intake and relative deprivation in terms of caloric intake. Depending on the measure of welfare, the impact of agricultural productivity was estimated with a household fixed effects estimator, a two-part estimator or a correlated-random effect ordered probit estimator. The results indicate that growth in agricultural productivity has the expected welfare-improving effect. In terms of economic magnitude, however, both the direct effect and economy-wide spillover effect (in the non-farm sector) of a percentage increase in agricultural productivity on the poverty and food security measures are small. Efforts to effectively improve the welfare of rural agricultural households should therefore go beyond merely increasing agricultural (land) productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用马拉维农村地区两轮具有全国代表性的面板数据，分析农业生产率对微观层面福利的影响。福利通过贫困和粮食不安全的多个维度衡量；农业生产率则以每公顷玉米产量和作物产出价值衡量。贫困指标包括人均消费支出、人均消费支出的相对剥夺、贫困缺口以及贫困严重程度；粮食不安全指标包括热量摄入以及热量摄入的相对剥夺。根据福利指标的不同，我们分别使用家庭固定效应估计量、两部分估计量或相关随机效应有序probit估计量来估计农业生产率的影响。结果表明，农业生产率的增长具有预期的福利改善效应。然而，就经济规模而言，农业生产率每提高一个百分点，其对贫困和粮食安全指标的直接效应以及对非农部门的全经济溢出效应都很小。因此，要切实改善农村农业家庭的福利，就不能仅仅依靠提高农业（土地）生产率，还需要做更多工作。

title: Storage Decisions in Smallholder Rural Households Under Liquidity and Technology Constraints
Transactions Costs in Land Rental Markets and Their Impact on Youth Access to Agriculture in Tanzania
abstract: We use three waves of nationally representative panel data from Tanzania to estimate the extent to which land rental markets provide a pathway for youth to enter into agriculture. We also investigate how transaction costs may impede youth access to renting-in land. Results suggest that rental markets are important mechanisms through which young farmers access land, but younger farmers face higher transaction costs when renting land than do older farmers. We also find evidence that younger farmers pay higher prices for rented land and are somewhat less likely to belong to village savings groups than are their older counterparts. (JEL O12, Q15)
abstract_zh: 我们利用坦桑尼亚具有全国代表性的三轮面板数据，估计了土地租赁市场在多大程度上为青年进入农业提供了途径。我们还考察了交易成本如何阻碍青年租入土地。结果表明，租赁市场是年轻农民获取土地的重要机制，但与年长农民相比，年轻农民在租地时面临更高的交易成本。我们还发现，年轻农民为租入土地支付的价格更高，并且相较于年长农民，他们加入村级储蓄互助组的可能性略低。（JEL O12, Q15）
